name: Quiver Quant
description: Quiver Quant gives you access to financial datasets that track where money and influence intersect. Pull stock transactions disclosed by members of Congress and the President, corporate insiders, hedge funds, and more. Investigate executive compensation, corporate lobbying spend, and government contract awards — all filterable by stock ticker. This MCP also provides access to a curated stock market newsfeed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Quiver Quant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Quiver Quant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quiverquant.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Quiver Quant MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quiver Quant lists 19 MCP tools, including compare_tickers, get_congress_legislation, get_congress_politician, get_congress_trades, get_corporate_donors, get_dark_pool, get_executive_compensation, get_gov_contracts, get_insider_trading, get_institutional_holdings, get_lobbying, and get_patents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Quiver Quant?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Quiver Quant in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Quiver Quant MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quiver Quant requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Quiver Quant is developed by Quiver Quantitative. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
